utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Thank you and good morning, Your Honour. This is case number IT-03-67-R77.4, In the Matter of Vojislav Seselj.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE TRECHSEL
utterances.text: [Microphone not activated]

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: I cannot hear anything now, the same problem as on the start of the last time.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE TRECHSEL
utterances.text: I'm sorry, I did not press the button for the microphone. Did you have the translation?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: No, I have not anything.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE TRECHSEL
utterances.text: How about now? Do you hear me now? Do you hear the translation?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Now I can hear you but barely. I'm saying this to the interpreter, actually.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE TRECHSEL
utterances.text: Thank you. I'm sure that --

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] It's better now, yes.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE TRECHSEL
utterances.text: Very good. Good morning to everyone again. Mr. Seselj, we are going on from where we stopped last Tuesday, and you have been told that the Chamber would not change its Rules for this trial, which means that you have the possibility to take the witness-stand and deposit as a witness. Your advisor, Mr. Mirovic, I take it, is not here; is that right? He is not here?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] You continue to violate my procedural and substantive rights consistently --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE TRECHSEL
utterances.text: Mr. Seselj, I just --

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Why would he be here when you forbade Nemanja Sarovic from coming?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE TRECHSEL
utterances.text: I just asked you a question. Is Mr. Mirovic here?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] You are putting nonsensical questions. You see that I am sitting here on my own. Where could Mr. Mirovic possibly be?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE TRECHSEL
utterances.text: He could be waiting outside, but apparently he is not. If you decide to deposit, the Chamber has decided that it would be simply giving you the possibility to state your view on the facts of this case. So you would not really be interrogated. Does that make a difference for you? Because last time you said you didn't trust me, you expected to be tricked by questions; and now I tell you we will not actually interrogate you but just give you the opportunity to state your view on the facts of this case.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Mr. Trechsel, you're going to do nothing today because I'm not going to give up on my procedural rights. Last time you said that these proceedings were too simple and therefore a Case Manager was not needed. As a matter of fact, your interpreter was saying "pravni referent" instead of "rukovodilac predmeta." Not in a single case before the Hague Tribunal did it happen that a Case Manager was superfluous. My main trial is a very simple one, the simplest one in The Hague Tribunal. Ten years ago Zoran Djindjic, the Mafia prime minister of Serbia asked Carla del Ponte the following: Take him away, don't send him back. And since then I've been here. Since then I've been struggling with you and your colleagues over the most elementary procedural rights, and I'm not going to give in one iota. I haven't got a legal advisor. I haven't got a Case Manager. No proceedings. Actually, there can be proceedings. You can finish this straight away. You can state for the record the accused refused to mount a Defence because he has been denied his procedural rights. He has been denied a Case Manager, a legal advisor, and then everything will be done.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE TRECHSEL
utterances.text: As you have said so yourself now, it is, in fact, on the record, Mr. Seselj. And in this situation, I cannot but note that the administration of evidence phase of the trial is over. You will not present any factual submissions on this case, which is absolutely your right. It means that we come to the last stage of the trial -- do you want to? I'm sorry, my colleague wants to intervene.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE TRECHSEL
utterances.text: I am correctly advised that I should state what you know and we know, namely, that all the material germane to this trial, all the documents, are already in the record and we are not in need of any further documents. That brings us to the last phase, which is the phase of submissions. And you have the opportunity, Mr. Seselj, to speak and to state what you want to state for your Defence. You have the floor.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] These are third contempt proceedings against me. In the first two proceedings, although these proceedings were very simple too, you retained a friend of the Court from Canada, from the state of Manitoba. You involved him in the prosecution, and then that even wasn't sufficient. Then he also had an assistant who had the right to address the Court directly. And then when the Iceland volcano erupted, then that was an excuse for that amicus curiae not to come from Manitoba. So you are highly partial. You are not objective at all. You are not providing me with elementary things. Fifteen Prosecutors appeared in these proceedings and who knows how many assistants. I always sit here on my own. Well, now I don't want to sit here on my own. I have the right to have my legal advisor here in the courtroom with me, Dejan Mirovic LL.M., and my Case Manager, Nemanja Sarovic, who also has a degree in law. In these proceedings, I did not ask you to pay for the professional services they provide to me but you have to pay their travel expenses. Now, this is the problem here. The Registry is refusing to register Nemanja Sarovic as Case Manager. Nemanja Sarovic is the Case Manager in the main proceedings. He was also Case Manager in the previous contempt proceedings. Now, all of a sudden, the Registry does not want to have him registered. Well, that cannot be done that way and I'm going to prove it to you that you cannot act that way and you do whatever you want. However, you are violating procedural law terribly, and I believe that all of this works against the authority of The Hague Tribunal, the professional authority of The Hague Tribunal. And, basically, my fundamental objective is to prove that you are in a legal court and not a single honourable and honest man ever agreed to act as a judge in this Court. I said that to you last time and you were flabbergasted, but that is a generally known fact and everyone in the world knows this. Which honest and honourable person would agree to be in your shoes? No one, especially not in the shoes of Mr. Kwon, who signed a false indictment against me. And then when as Vice-President of the Tribunal he was supposed to take a decision on the recusal of another Judge, he recused himself because he appeared once in the pre-trial stage. However, that did not prevent him from appearing in three contempt proceedings and pretending to be a Judge.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE TRECHSEL
utterances.text: Please proceed.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Why would I? There is no need for me to proceed. As far as I'm concerned, you can state your verdict straight away. What I have to say, I'm going to say in the appeal. You have prevented me from mounting a Defence. I just added to the procedural objections I had, and I have not even touched on the merits of this case. You prevented me from doing so. The fact that I am self represented does not mean that I have to appear totally by myself in this courtroom. I am entitled to professional and expert assistance and also I'm entitled to technical assistance.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE TRECHSEL
utterances.text: Does this end your submissions for this moment, Mr. Seselj, or is there anything you would like to add?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Yes, yes. No.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE TRECHSEL
utterances.text: In that case, I declare the trial proceedings here closed. I wish to thank all those who have assisted the Chamber, this includes of course the interpreters, but also the translators who are far in the background but who worked diligently in order to get all the documents translated. The hearing is adjourned.

procedural_notes.text: --- Whereupon the hearing adjourned at 9.16 a.m.
